verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API whose specification is the IETF RFCs (8620, 8621, 9610), discovered through a session object that advertises capabilities. That is standards-based stability and capability negotiation, not an explicit API versioning scheme. The evidence pack contains no documented deprecation policy or version-sunset commitments, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
